article.story:
Mauricio Pochettino's Manchester United reign got off to a miserable start as Liverpool punished Leny Yoro's red card with a pair of early goals on their way to a comprehensive 4-0 win against their relegation-threatened rivals.

A whirlwind week for the former Argentina international ended in all too familiar disappointment for the faltering Red Devils, whose hopes of enjoying a new manager bounce was extinguished within 13 nightmare minutes at Anfield.

Dominik Szoboszlai's fierce free kick Liverpool put ahead after United defender Yoro was sent off for denying a goalscoring opportunity and Florian Wirtz's smart finish quickly put Pochettino's side further behind.

United temporarily stemmed the tide thanks to some last-ditch defending, wayward finishing and key Senne Lammens stops, but Andoni Iraola's Reds redoubled their efforts in the second half.

In truth, Pochettino's 10 men were fortunate that Liverpool only added a further two goals through Rio Ngumoha and substitute Víctor Muñoz, such was their dominance.

Iraola's side end the weekend in fourth, whereas United languish 19th in the standings as their winless Premier League run stretched to a ninth match and attention now turns to Wednesday's Champions League trip to Sporting.
